<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex15012024-11-08-11-58" status="unreviewed">
            dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom nam <note type="gloss"/>'go bla ma</rs><!--tentative identiication as 'Bron ston--> na re don dang mi mthun pa kho na <lb n="56b5"/> yin te rtog pa 'khrul pa 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir zhes gsung pa ni ma yin te |             rtog pa chos kyi dbyongs las 'khrul ba'i phyir zhes 'god na ma nges ste | sngo 'dzin tshad mas kun rdzob tu don dang mi mthun par thal te chos kyi dbyings la 'khrul ba'i phyir ro || 
             rtags tshad ma khyab pa khas blangs 'dod na tshad ma yin pa shes so || rtogs kun rdzob kyi
            <lb n="56b6"/>gnas lugs la 'khrul ba rtags su 'god na ma grub po || gal te grub na 'di dag spong pa la gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i chos nyid rtogs m'i dgos par 'gyur te | kun rdzob shes pa'i tshad mas spong pa'i phyir thag pa la sbrul 'dzin no || 'dod na mthong pa dang bsgom pas spang par bya ba'i zhes pas bsal ba'o || gzhan yang kuns skon dang rnaM byang
            <lb n="56b7"/>dag kyang kuns ston dang rnaM byang ma yin par 'gyur te gzung rtog 2 kyis de dag du rtog pa'i phyir ro || rtags rang rig gis grub cing khyab pa ma grub na don dang mi mthun pa shaMs la 'dod na de dag yin pas bsalo || </seg></TEI>
